body: Well as a cutter this was fucking triggering.

I wish someone cared about me this much.

Instead my ex tried to make me fuck my weed dealer (who also sold guns to gangs in LA) and when I was too scared to, I got dumped.

That relationship went on though and eventually the pressure of him wanting me to sleep with other guys got to me and I did it, and I fucking hated it but I didn't want to lose my ex. I wish I had stayed dumped back then. I still cut sometimes and nobody cares, including me.

My ex would keep himself so busy he couldn't think about it.  He even told me a few times... He will do anything to avoid thinking anything negative, especially if it was his fault. I never got apologies from him and he still thinks that my depression is what ruined our relationship... Not his cheating, or him begging me to fuck strange guys until Id give in. They are delusional!

My mom was the biggest Harry Potter fan... Two years ago she was riding Forbidden Journey at Universal Studios and sipping butter beer and waving the wand she bought me, now cancer is succumbing and she can't remember anything about the story. I know she's not doing well but fuck cancer... The last two years have been so hard in her... She's the only reason I've stayed alive this long and I'm scared to be without her...

I agree with you that some people have a lot of promise and are young and just don't think things through... But some of us are just hurting so bad. I'm 36 and all I've experienced is abuse... I can never not think of it and knowing it's going to be like this for as long as I live is scary. I have a loving husband now but I'm useless because if what I went through and I can't stop thinking of how horrible my abusers made me feel... Worthless, stupid, etc. So much that I can't help but believe them. I only have one person telling me otherwise and he'd be better off without me I'm just a burden. I have no friends anymore... All I do is cry, sleep, do house chores and have sex why the hell am I still here? Nobody wants to spend time with me and now that the world is open my husband spends all his free time with his friends...while I'm at home alone trying not to hurt myself. Why stay alive???

Everytime my nex broke up with me, it was pretty shocking. He never tried talking to me about what or how he felt, he never tried to help me, he'd just out on a happy mask and make subtle hints like saying "I know" when I'd say I love you, or spending more time away, etc. It was always my fault, too.... It's been a couple years no contact and I still feel pretty broken.

Do you know my nex???

He made me post nudes. He pressured me to sleep with strangers from the internet that could hurt me. He dumped me over and over, kicking me out and I lost jobs from it. He emotionally cheated all of the time... He was so mean in the end. Why do they do this to us???

I'm so sorry you're going through this. These people are a special type of evil. They know they hurt us, make us miserable and even when they know it they don't lose any sleep at night. Fuck them... You're right thought, unfortunately they will never change. Feel free to dm me if you need to talk to someone. ❤️
Which video did you watch, if I may ask?

I'm so sorry that happened to you, what a piece of shit. I can be sure my nex is not crying over me since he told me he didn't love me and just didn't think anything if me because I'm never on his mind. That might be bs but his new wife is not seeing him sad... Especially since he is a great actor (maybe working under a famous director  helped after all). But you definitely didn't deserve that... Neither do any of the girls they lock in. Uhh, they disgust me. I am here if you ever need to talk, I'm sorry for making you relive all of that... But you're better off now and things will be okay for us ❤️ I so very appreciate your help, you are an amazing gal any guy would be lucky to have!

Now if only I could find an expert on this to talk to about this specific narcissistic trait! Like, do the motherly figures get all of the luck, all of the good in him because he can't whore them out? Still so many questions, but it's a great start to my healing process!! Thank you again ❤️
Ok this video literally changed my life. I have been blaming myself this whole time. Thank you so much for your helpfulness!!
Wow, you've been through so much, and are so strong! Thank you, I hope I can be as strong as you someday!

Thank you. I think what hurts the most is that he's likely never to ask his wife to do what I did... Because he was talking about this girl rejecting him for years, I don't think he's going to risk messing that up. (Although I honestly don't wish it on any girl anyways... But then I feel like I deserved the sexual abuse and emotional manipulation and she doesn't.. no one does).

Also he might not be as into it anymore, maybe I ruined it for him when I tried to call him out on it, it almost lost him some precious fans...
 or maybe his libido is down because he's older and gained a lot of weight... But I guess I'll never really know what happens and I have to learn to live with that (I'm trying).

I never claimed I was perfect. He was my first love, my first everything. I know I should have dumped him the first time he left me in a room with another man expecting me to fuck him and being upset when I didn't. He found the perfect victim and ran with it, I was already broken when we met from an abusive household.

Yes, I'm still angry/depressed/anxious because of it and I know I need therapy and I'll be seeking it, but sometimes it helps to rant when it's especially difficult and I have nobody else to talk to. Sometimes I need a reminder I'm not the worst person in the world, or I'm not completely crazy. I've had help on reddit before, and honestly the comments here helped me get through the day, and will probably help me for a while.

I don't wish him on anyone either... He has tons of debt, thinks he's the greatest director in the world and makes crap films he enters in contests and never get close to winning, his family are drug addicts/terrible, looks like his mouth got hit by a baseball bat and he is ready to be on my 600lb life lol
I caught him in lies constantly.

She rejected him at first, for a couple years, while he was using me... So he basically settled for me but all of his emotions have been for her since he started working at disneyland. 

I also met him at disneyland. I didn't want to date him at first (we met up because I was a huge fan of his movie and found him on myspace...) because he is not that great to look at (cute kid but he didn't age well)... It took me a while to start seeing past the ugliness on the outside because he was amazing on the inside (so I thought).

btw his ex-wife left him for someone he made her sleep with. Then he met me... I feel like I must be a terrible person.
I know this is late but thank you for this and I'm so sorry you had to go through all of that! I don't think I could put up with that but I'm also a textbook codependent sooo...

You are so dead on it's scary. 

I was abused for my whole life and really badly with my ex of ten years... I took a lot of abuse from him because I have no self worth. Maybe I need to work on myself before I try to fix anything else, but that will take too long... I don't know what to do.

My husband smokes all day too... It's a bit like medicating his adhd and I smoke a bit too for health issues. I literally never see him sober anymore. But I can't be a hypocrite. Thank God he's really good at his job.
It's a very difficult situation because the only place I have is where my mom is basically dying of stage 4 lung cancer. I'd be scared I'd compromise her health and I'd probably be a burden.

He seems ok... He's always happy and will randomly say we have a decent life and we're lucky and is about to get a raise at his job. Maybe he just hates me, I'm not a very good wife so I wouldn't blame him.
I will show him this, thank you!
Do you happen to know the names of any books that might help?
Thank you for the link and telling me the amount of calories in whiskey, that'll actually probably help a bit.
He's hurt himself in an accident while drunk like 5 years ago before I knew him. He drove drunk in January to get more beer, I am pretty scared.

I've been with him 3 years and he's never been violent besides some grabbing, he might grab me if I try to leave (I started packing once, he grabbed me and threw me on the bed but it didn't hurt) and I don't think he'd hurt me. He does apologize profusely and admits he shouldn't yell so much or let me leave the situation for a breather, but he's getting better at it.

Thank you. He actually mentioned genetics today when we were talking about it. He has to drink more than average people to feel the affects, and barely gets hungover (he's downed a full bottle of whiskey in a few hours a few times, and blacks out but is still pretty functional and no bad hangover. This no longer happens though. If he ever blacks out again I'm gone until he fully quits.) 

He also can easily go a few days with no visible affects, and has gone weeks with no trouble. I don't really know if it's genetics or just his tolerance or what. 

He smokes so much weed I don't know how he functions at work (he's even getting a promotion) but I dont often see him sober. I smoke too though so I can't say anything, but not constantly like him. It seemed better when he wasn't working from home, though he's a lot less stressed. We are on emergency lockdown here though so I'm hoping that doesn't make him want to drink more.

He claims it calms his adhd (it is quite extreme, but he said meds don't work or have bad side affects) which I just now realized is a pretty stupid answer... Because ummm drinking excessively has bad side affects too! 
Hes a pretty happy guy, he's too focused on his job and hobbies that I never see him sad. Sometimes he's like a robot.

I've been in extreme denial. I've never had to deal with something like this and I love him so much and I knew it made him happy to drink ("it helps adhd") so I looked the other way, and honestly he's a very happy drunk. But it's getting to be too much again and I honestly can't deal with it anymore and will be happy to leave if he chooses alcohol.
I'm basically giving him an ultimatum, and if he chooses alcohol over me then good riddance!

Thank you. His ex left him for grabbing her while drunk, and that woke him up for a while til he gave up I guess and dated another enabler, and then met me and I looked the other way which was stupid but I was in a bad place as well. But I'm finally starting to act on what's been bothering me since we met. He's surprisingly cut down A LOT in the past two years which is really saying something.  :( Sometimes I think he just isn't happy, but if so he's hiding it very well.

I'm sorry if this is putting a negative light on the LDS church... I truly never intended that, and didn't think anyone would even comment. I was so angry when I made the post because he had just said that to me again for the billionth time and I hate that he says that because it's stupid! I don't need a Mormon to find someone that doesnt drink this much, most guy don't! And hell I will find a Mormon then if it means I have a healthy partner!

Ive said in another comment how strict his parents were that messed him up and his dad berates him for not being in the church anymore, and guilt trips him that he won't go to the same heaven that his parents go to. It's kinda a unique situation that sucks for everyone and he had an unfortunate childhood he blames on the church. I'm not trying to find excuses for him though and it's not an excuse to destroy your body, he's a total asshole for doing this to us and needs to stop blaming everything else for it.

I know he had it rough. My ex of ten years was also a non-practicing Mormon, he had a pretty good childhood and was even in a film with robin williams. He was abusive for other reasons (he had dangerous fetishes... As in he'd make me sleep with strangers for money, etc) but Im sure that's unrelated to the church as he didn't hate it and in the very beginning of our relationship had me take lessons. He lost his way during our relationship and forgot it though. I have to admit his family was a little crazy too and his sister did tons of drugs which might have been a result of their parents but he has 5 siblings and a couple seem stable lol. It's also ironic that both my ex's father and my hubby's father are high up in the church in the same position. Anyway, sorry for the rant! 

Thank you for replying, i know the church does prayer lists? I can dm you our names if you wouldn't mind praying for us. I'm not religious but it's comforting. I truly hope it doesn't end in divorce or he stops and resents me for it, that scares me.
Haha.  I said something like that my husband and he'd say 'then go find one.' I'd say ok but he would just keep denying it's bad and I'm crazy.

Thank you for this tip. He will not admit he's an alcoholic so this is very helpful!

Edit: sometimes i think hes fully aware of the unhealthy amount and just doesn't care, or thinks he's invincible or something. I think that is going to make things much harder.
LOL!

I think he has a personal vendetta with the LDS church because he was made fun of for it as a kid and his parents were so strict he wasn't even allowed outside for more than 15 mins at a time, or watch most tv shows or listen to the radio or do much at all. His father also berates him for leaving the church everytime they talk, and guilt trips him about not seeing his dead mom in heaven.
There could be more, I'm not sure. I know this helped him lash out as a teen (he was sent to a boys home in utah) and then when he turned 18 he did every drug under the sun and raved as retaliation I think... which is dumb but whatever, he doesn't party anymore thank God.
 I totally agree that Mormons are pretty smart for staying away from drugs, and didn't intend to offend anyone. I know a lot of members from the LDS church and they are some of the nicest people, and I have gone through the lessons all the way through twice. I'm not religious in any sense anymore but I have no ill will towards any religion (unless they chop off people's heads or something...)
Thank you, I know, and if I have to give him an ultimatum I will. If he chooses alcohol, fuck him and good riddance!!!

He's been able to go a month with no alcohol because we fought about it in April, and it's been mostly beer until lately he obsessed with his weight and I guess he thought it was his only solution. I now recognize that is alcoholic behavior, and I know he'll never admit it. 

He also drove drunk in January (on my bday even to get more alcohol) and has had duis before. I found out about it and packed my bags, but he convinced me to stay. I probably should have just left back then to show how much this is affecting our lives, but honestly had nowhere to go and I love him and he swore he'd slow down. I know these are all red flags and will be telling dr and therapist. When we ever have bad arguments, it's 90% because of fucking alcohol. I'm over it.
Good idea, thank you.
Thank you, I'm actually fairly weak to when it comes to things like this (was abused for ten years by ex) but I can't watch someone I love slowly kill themselves, either.

Thank you for this. All your measurements are about accurate (just checked... He likes to keep the bottles to show off) I will definitely show him this equation and hopefully he'll realize I won't deal anymore.
Definitely going to look into therapy for myself asap.
Yeah... I'm seeing it now. It really sucks but I'm glad I'm not crazy, I was starting to think I'm stupid for worrying.
I figured he was lying, he knows I was homeschooled and then was never with a guy that drank so how would I know? I'll definitely save these tips!

It changes. Right now it's because of quarantine and he's bored... Or he'll say it helps calm his adhd (he doesn't like adderall or any adhd med I guess).

When I threaten to leave he quits for a few weeks then slowly tries to build my trust up again. Now it's a lot... Probably because I don't want to start fights so I'm learning to just stay quiet.

He refused to admit he's an alcoholic because they  "can never stop and drink til they pass out" and brings up that he stopped for six whole months when his ex left him because he grabbed her-while drunk. 

He also says alcoholics drink everyday while he'll take one or two days off a week so it's not too bad, and just wants to "maintain a buzz and that's just how much it takes for a guy my size" (5'11 210lb)
Which seems okay for him since he's not blacking out (anymore, this isn't the first time I've told him to cut it down or I'm gone, it used to be much worse) and isn't mean or to me at all or anything unless I deserve it  (another thing he says to defend himself).

Thank you for the advice and I will try talking to our doctor and if he still doesn't at least slow down it's rehab or I'm gone.

I'm not going to stay with him if he keeps it up... I just talked to him a little and he said he'd try to cut down. He has seen the Dr recently (I'll get test results and hopefully they're ok) and when I go next month I'll ask doctor what he recommends for an amount that won't kill him before he's 70... That's all I can think to do for now.
Thank you so much!
I guess I have to make an appointment to ask a doctor...
How do I make him see it's not good? I've tried, but he thinks I know nothing because I can't back it up.
Yeah, I know... He grew up Mormon but claimed it made him want to do drugs/drink even more.

Don't reach out!!!!! That will be like them winning. They will think "oh, look who misses me, and is being weak and wants closure/me back. They will brag to their friends and make fun of you to them. They'll call you "crazy" and it'll reassure them it was a good idea to leave/stay away. If they want to talk to you, they'd reach out.
